firstDeploymentPolicy.exactQuote: The first deployment of a new project is always a production deployment.

readOnlyAudit.sourceCaveat: This actual run is a GET-only credential audit, not a Preview redeployment or successful bootstrap.

verifiedFacts: Full Account, Team, Project are distinct scopes.
Project scope denies team/user resources and other projects.
Team -> All Projects is the team-scoped option.
Scoped tokens infer their team/project without teamId.
Project-scoped tokens cannot mint new tokens.
No credential ID, name, prefix, suffix or raw metadata will be published.
GET /v10/projects is a documented read-only credential check for all three token scopes.
Array and paginated project-list responses are both valid.
403 is permission denial, not proof of expiration or an invalid value.
Developer can receive Create Project; Member/Owner already include it.
Full Production Deployment is a different extended permission, not requested here.
First deployment of a new project is Production even from a non-production branch.
No safe bypass was proved; all writes stay disabled.

correctionsToPreviousAdvice: A project-scoped token can be valid while GET /v2/teams/{id} returns 403.
Owner role and Full Account scope are not blanket minimum requirements.
The prior 403 alone does not establish the current token scope or why it was denied.

minimumForCurrentReadOnlyProjectEvidence.privileges: Read-only project/deployment/build-log access; no Owner, mutation or token-creation privilege required.

minimumForFutureSeparateProjectProvision.roleCapability: Developer plus Create Project, with rights to configure/link the new project and read/create Preview deployments; Member is sufficient but broader. Owner is not mandatory.
